learnings: `raise X from exc` keeps the original error as `__cause__` for debugging.
`ExceptionGroup` reports many validation problems at once; `except*` handles each kind.
Retry only transient errors, with backoff, and re-raise the last one.
pitfalls: `logging.exception` records the traceback; printing `str(exc)` loses it.
